Q: Thanks for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident and my injuries, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?
A: It was in a parking lot in League City, Texas, at a shopping center. I was pulling out of a parking space near the
front entrance.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I had checked my mirror, saw nothing behind me, and started backing out slowly. I was going maybe five miles an
hour.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle at any point?
A: Not until right before it hit my rear passenger side. It came down the aisle fairly fast, I think, and I didn't have time
to react.
Q: Did you stop after the impact?
A: Yes, I put the car in park right away. The other driver got out and came over to check on me.
Q: Did you notice any injuries to yourself at the scene?
A: My head snapped forward and then back against the headrest. I felt dizzy and had a ringing in my ears. I didn't
think much of it at first.
Q: When did you first seek medical care?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic that evening becuase the headache got worse. They sent me for a scan and told me
I had a concussion.
Q: Have you had any symptoms since then?
A: Yes. I still get headaches in the afternoon, I have trouble concentrating at work, and birght lihgts bother me. My
doctor has me on rest and reduced screen time.
Q: Have you missed any work because of this?
A: I've been out part of the week and working shortened days the rest of the time. I'm stlil working with my doctor on
when I can go back full time.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I want my records to show how much this has affected my daily routine. Thank you.
</page>

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
